multi_agent_overlap_analysis.convergence_vs_divergence: The 4 CCAI sub-agents within a single round CONVERGE strongly - they share Claude training-set and prompt-shape. R47 BLOCKERs were both cross-paper / cross-section consistency issues, the kind any Claude agent surfaces. The 4 sub-agents do NOT diverge enough to surface the 6 OOOOO BLOCKERs.
multi_agent_overlap_analysis.agent_role_overlap: Each of the 4 CCAI sub-agents reviewed 1 different paper, so no within-paper redundancy. The 'cross-paper' visibility is therefore ZERO at the sub-agent level - it only emerges in the consolidator's summary step, but the consolidator is also Claude and inherits the same blindspots.
multi_agent_overlap_analysis.implication: Adding more CCAI agents does not buy attack-surface diversity. Adding non-Anthropic vendors does. The OOOOO cross-vendor round exposed this empirically: 4 vendors found 50 findings where 4 CCAI agents found 4.

per_paper_split_vs_cross_paper_split_fin.observation: The per-paper R47/R48 split files (R47_CCAI_P1A.md etc) DO surface more findings than the cross-paper summary (~7-9 per paper in detail vs ~3-4 mentioned in summary). The cross-paper summary compresses to BLOCKERs and headline MAJORs and drops MINORs and nuanced framings.
patterns_per_paper_view_unmasks: Three-contradictory-labels-for-one-number (R47-P3-M1: 17.8% as 'provisional upper bound' AND 'single-sample point estimate' AND 'novelty floor')
patterns_cross_paper_view_unmasks: Cross-paper companion-cite anchor mismatches (R47-P1A-B1: footnote -> Paper 1B section that does not exist)
per_paper_split_vs_cross_paper_split_fin.recommendation: Per-paper split is the load-bearing surface. Cross-paper summary should be derived from the splits, not used as the master.

recommendation_two_stage_pre_review_chec.recommendation: YES - /paper-pre-review-check should explicitly become a TWO-STAGE protocol

stage_1_ccai_self_review.purpose: Catch mechanical regressions, sub-agent closure-wave introduced defects (pattern-008), narrative-continuity drift, severity-progression-within-paper
stage_1_ccai_self_review.convergence_signal: <3B+<5M for 2 consecutive rounds is a NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT gate

stage_2_cross_vendor_diversity.purpose: Catch the 6 CCAI blind spots identified above (external citation retrieval, cross-paper consistency, dimensional derivation, Fisher reproducibility, severity calibration, editorial hygiene)
stage_2_cross_vendor_diversity.convergence_signal: TWO consecutive cross-vendor rounds at <3B+<5M with the second round on a re-prep version that closed the first round's findings (per Houston's RRRRR-prep protocol)

stage_3_external_journal_reviewer.purpose: Catch the meta-blind-spot of internal-only review (pattern-018 editorial hygiene). Confirmed by P1A external 3-reviewer round where 8 internal CCAI-style rounds had 0 VERIFIED but external found 9 sites of pattern-017 artifacts.
stage_3_external_journal_reviewer.implementation: /paper-pre-review-check --strict mode that runs pattern-014 + 017 + 018 greps and BLOCKS submission until cleared

recommendation_two_stage_pre_review_chec.gate_arithmetic: OOOOO showed CCAI exit at 4 findings -> cross-vendor surfaced 50. Ratio 12.5x. This is the strongest empirical argument in the entire CCAI cluster for mandatory cross-vendor step BEFORE any external submission and BEFORE any readiness >= 99%.

implications_for_readiness_cap_99_skill.current_rule: Cap at 95% until clean CCAI R-round + clean cross-vendor R-round + Houston sign-off
implications_for_readiness_cap_99_skill.evidence: If readiness had been lifted to 99% after CCAI R47-R50 convergence (the literal text says 'four-consecutive-round <3B+<5M post-closure'), the 6 OOOOO BLOCKERs would have been missed - including a fake arXiv ID (B6), a not-reproducible 9.9 sigma Fisher (B2), and a sigma(f_NL) factor-of-10 mismatch with literature (B3).
implications_for_readiness_cap_99_skill.strengthening_proposal: Backward-step requirement: a paper that took >5pp backward in cross-vendor R-round must run a SECOND cross-vendor round on the post-closure version BEFORE lifting cap. OOOOO took -6.2pp backward; RRRRR (the second cross-vendor on post-PPPPP) is the load-bearing confirmation, not OOOOO closure alone.
